## [1.0.0-dev.3](https://github.com/Dreaming-Codes/morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.2...v1.0.0-dev.3) (2026-10-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Show the photo picker entry in every gallery that can import it ([#4](https://github.com/Dreaming-Codes/morphe-patches/issues/4)) ([a9d686f](https://github.com/Dreaming-Codes/morphe-patches/commit/a9d686f6d8b30fee941f5a6c091c687db42a3105))

patches.name: Use system photo picker
patches.description: Adds an entry to the DM, stories, reels, and full-screen creation gallery album lists that opens the Android system photo picker. The picker also shows media from cloud media providers such as Immich.

repoDescription: Morphe patches by Dreaming-Codes. First patch makes Instagram use the Android system photo picker.
